study: Late-day flow from leveraged-ETF rebalancing. On sessions with a large move by 15:30, does the underlying index or sector ETF keep moving in that direction from 15:30 to 15:50, net of cost? A forced-flow test, not an indicator test.
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any return in this study was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19, after the project review. Leveraged and inverse ETFs must trade in the direction of the day's move near the close to reset their leverage (the flow is roughly (L^2 - L) x AUM x the day's return). If that flow moves prices, big days continue into the close.
prior_evidence: Weak and negative, stated before the run. Round 2 (2026-09-26) tested Gao-style momentum from 15:30 on 15 index and sector ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, XLY, XLP, XLI, XLU, XLB, XLRE, XLC) over 2025-09-29..2026-09-25 and promoted one rule on SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA. Round 3 re-tested that rule on 2020-07..2025-09 IEX history with no retuning: day-weighted -1.6 bp, t -1.71 (STRATEGY_EDGE_ROUND2_2026-09-26.md, round 3). So XLF, XLE, XLP and XLU over the round-2 window, and SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA over 2020-07..2025-09, have been seen. This prereg uses a different rule (the day's own move to 15:29, the leveraged-ETF rebalance mechanism) on SIP from 2016, with SMH and XBI new.

instruments.SPY: SPXL, UPRO, SPXU, SPXS, SSO, SDS
instruments.SMH: SOXL, SOXS (SOXX index family; SMH is the liquid unlevered proxy)

signal: For instrument i on session s: r = close of the 15:29 SIP 1-minute bar / prior session's daily SIP close - 1. Minute and daily bars both use Adjustment.ALL, so ex-dividend drops are not moves. Big day: |r| at or above the 80th percentile of |r| over i's previous 60 sessions (the first 60 sessions fetched are warm-up and are not scored). Trade sign(r).
trade: Enter at the open of the 15:30 SIP bar, exit at the close of the 15:49 bar (the desk's 15:50 flatten). Information: exit at the close of the 15:59 bar. Long when r > 0, short when r < 0.
flow_size: Information, not the call: the session's estimated rebalance flow in dollars, sum over the listed leveraged ETFs of (L^2 - L) x shares outstanding x price x r, divided by i's 20-day median dollar volume 15:30-16:00. Only if historical shares outstanding are available from a free source; otherwise not printed and stated as missing.
return: Gross bp in the trade direction. Net subtracts the measured SIP quoted spread for that symbol-month (median of SIP quotes at 15:31 on two sampled sessions a month, as tools/studies/edge3_longhist.py does) plus 1 bp slippage. A flat 5 bp net is printed beside it. A symbol-month with no spread sample is charged the flat 5 bp, never filled from another month, and the count of such symbol-months is printed.

controls.all_days: The same 15:30->15:49 trade in the direction of r on that instrument's non-big sessions in the same half. Excess: each big-day trade minus that instrument's non-big mean, then session-clustered. Per instrument, so the excess does not depend on how many instruments a set has. The all-session mean is printed as information.
controls.placebo_etfs: XLP and XLU, whose leveraged products are small, run through the identical rule. Lev minus placebo is, per session where both sets had a big-day trade, the lev set's mean excess minus the placebo set's mean excess (excess as in controls.all_days). The flow claim needs that mean > 0 in both halves and session-clustered t >= 2 over A and B together; otherwise the result is late-day momentum, not leveraged-ETF flow, and is labelled MOMENTUM ONLY.
controls.drift: The plain long 15:30->15:49 return on the same big days. A long-only drift is not the flow.

halves: Half A: sessions 2016-03-01 through 2020-12-31. Half B: 2021-01-04 through 2026-10-16 excluding the round-2 window 2025-09-29..2026-09-25, which is printed separately as information and is never in the call. Nothing is fit: the percentile is each instrument's own trailing window.
call: Pooled over the 8 instruments, one trade per instrument per big day, clustered by session (each session's mean trade). PASS: net > 0 in both halves with day-clustered t >= 2 in each; big-day minus all-day excess > 0 in both halves; lev minus placebo (defined in controls.placebo_etfs) > 0 in both halves with combined t >= 2; a week-block bootstrap 95% interval of half-B net that excludes 0; and the net keeps its sign without the 10 best sessions and without 2020-02-01..2020-04-30. MOMENTUM ONLY: everything in PASS except the placebo condition. PROMISING (project tier): net > 0 in both halves, combined t >= 1.5, big-day minus all-day excess > 0 in both halves, and the same concentration checks keep the sign. UNDERPOWERED when a half has fewer than 150 big-day sessions. FAIL otherwise. Per-instrument results are printed and are not separate calls.
what_is_printed: Per half: big-day sessions, trades, gross, net at the measured spread, net 5 bp, t, week-block bootstrap interval, win share, all-day control and the excess with its t, the placebo set's same numbers, the long-drift control. Up days vs down days, by instrument, by year, and the round-2 window alone. The net without the 10 best sessions and without 2020-02..04. The 15:59 exit as information. Flow-size quintiles against gross if historical shares outstanding are available; stated as missing otherwise.
data: SIP 1-minute bars 15:25-16:00 and daily SIP bars, Adjustment.ALL, for the 8 instruments and XLP/XLU, 2015-10-01..2026-10-16 (the first 60 sessions are warm-up), fetched once on the data-only Alpaca account (secrets_data.json, never the desk key), cached under ai_reports/levetf_bars/. SIP quotes at 15:31 for the spread sample. A session missing the 15:29, 15:30 or 15:49 bar for an instrument is dropped for that instrument and counted.
known_limits: Fills: the live desk would enter with a marketable order at about 15:30 on IEX prices; SIP closes are used here, and on these ETFs the difference is a fraction of a bp. Not daily: about 1 session in 5 per instrument qualifies; across 8 instruments most sessions have at least one trade, but the instruments are highly correlated, which is why the call is clustered by session.
no_retuning: The instrument and placebo lists, the 80th percentile, the 60-session window, the bar timing, the cost rule, the halves, and the excluded round-2 window are fixed. Another threshold, window, entry time, or instrument is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY on this prereg and its script: REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python tools/studies/levetf_close.py --fetch (data account, outside 09:30-16:00 ET), then --score. No pytest over SSH. No config edit.
amendment_2026-10-19: Result-skeptic Mode 1 NOT READY before any script or result. Fixed: contamination stated correctly (XLF/XLE seen in round 2) and the round-2 window excluded from half B; bar timing and prior close defined, Adjustment.ALL; fetch from 2015-10 for warm-up; measured per symbol-month spread plus 1 bp; XLP/XLU placebo and a MOMENTUM ONLY word; excess required in PROMISING; concentration and week-block bootstrap in the call.
amendment_2026-10-19b: Before any result, found by the script's planted-edge test: 'leveraged excess above placebo excess in both halves' passes on noise about a quarter of the time (a planted edge on both sets read PASS). Lev minus placebo is now a per-session difference with combined t >= 2, as in controls.placebo_etfs. Also found by the planted-edge test: big-day minus all-session excess shrinks with the number of instruments in a set (8 lev vs 2 placebo), so the same edge looked twice as large on the lev set. Excess is now each big-day trade minus the same instrument's non-big mean in that half.
